Select the ChEMBL ID, preferred name, maximum phase, molecule type, and canonical SMILES for all molecules reported in the specified document. Join molecule_dictionary to compound_records on molregno, filter by doc_id matching the document CHEMBL ID, and join compound_structures to retrieve canonical SMILES. Return the output columns molecule_chembl_id, molecule_name, max_phase, molecule_type, and canonical_smiles. Sort the results by molecule_chembl_id in ascending order.
